title: SecMesh-PQSI: Formal Algebraic and Information-Theoretic Foundations and Cryptographic Defense Engine for Post-Quantum and Post-Super-Intelligence Meshes
description: Clean-room cryptographic refactoring of legacy SecMesh rebuilt atop Tsotchke's cryptographic, representation-theoretic, and quantum-geometry stack into a Levels 1-3 Post-Quantum and Post-Super-Intelligence (information-theoretic) mesh defense suite, backed by 28 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorem statements checked across 6 kernel runs (5 distinct implementations), bit-exact C11 Moonlab <-> OpenSSL 3.5.5 FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 interoperability, 5 live Eshkol AD modules, two companion AMS-LaTeX white papers, and a 3-page NIST executive brief.
